title: HAVSTORP door
description: HAVSTORP door, light gray, 18x50" HAVSTORP kitchen fronts in timeless light grey finish are defined by clean straight lines and smooth surface that create a neutral and harmonious expression that is easy to personalize. You can choose to mount the door on the right or left side.
features: Requires a knob or a handle
May be completed with HAVSTORP cover panels, plinth and decorative strip in light grey.
Complete with UTRUSTA 110° hinge with built-in damper for kitchen, 2-pack, sold separately.
